question: A hammer strikes a 1,000 mm string 125 mm from its end. Which is the lowest harmonic it cannot excite? Give its number.
answer: The lowest harmonic with a node at 1/8: the 8th.
move: A push delivered exactly where something stands still cannot start it moving.
trap: Answering 7, recalling the old lore that hammers silence the seventh.
hint: Each harmonic has still points, nodes, at fixed fractions of the length.
steps: The nth harmonic has nodes at every 1/n of the string.
Striking at a node cannot set that harmonic going.
The lowest harmonic with a node at 1/8: the 8th.
source: Helmholtz, On the Sensations of Tone
reference: Helmholtz, On the Sensations of Tone, trans. Ellis, Dover, 1954
